import 'dart:async';

import 'package:hazard_fixture/outside.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

void main() {
  // While the tests are declared.
  if (declared() != 1) {
    throw StateError('cannot be declared');
  }

  // When all tests have run.
  tearDownAll(() {
    if (closing() != 2) {
      throw StateError('cannot be closed');
    }
  });

  test('an error that nobody waits for', () async {
    unawaited(
      Future(() {
        if (stray() != 3) {
          throw StateError('stray');
        }
      }),
    );
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 20));
  });

  test('an error that arrives when its test has ended', () {
    Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 30), () {
      if (late() != 4) {
        throw StateError('late');
      }
    });
  });

  test('the test during which it arrives', () async {
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 150));
  });

  // Not called with a mutant: the test waits for it until its time is up.
  test('a callback that has to be called', () {
    final called = expectAsync0(() {});
    if (calls() == 5) {
      called();
    }
  });

  // Fails the first time, and passes when it is tried again.
  test('passes the second time', () {
    expect(attempt(), greaterThan(1));
  }, retry: 2);
}
